title: 'Marcha de la Bronca' Draws Thousands Nationwide Against Milei's Austerity Program
detail: Left-wing parties, trade unions, retirees, students, and human-rights groups staged the 'Marcha de la Bronca' (March of Anger), mobilizing in more than 30 cities nationwide with a central rally running from Congress to Plaza de Mayo in Buenos Aires. More than 350 organizations joined to protest Milei's austerity program, citing disability and university funding cuts, more than 30,000 company closures since December 2023, and rising unemployment. Thousands attended the Buenos Aires rally, among the largest anti-government demonstrations since Milei took office.

media.caption: Argentina's 'March of Anger' targets Milei's disability and university cuts

title: UK Minister Calls Argentina's Falklands Sanctions Campaign 'Unacceptable'
detail: UK Minister for Overseas Territories Uma Kumaran rejected Argentina's escalating legal and sanctions campaign against Falklands-linked oil companies as 'unacceptable' and carrying 'no legal justification,' reaffirming that the islands are British and that islanders have the right to develop their own natural resources under the principle of self-determination. The statement came two days after Argentina's Congress received the National Sovereignty Defense Law bill, and follows Argentina's sanctions proceedings against dozens of companies and individuals tied to Falklands oil activity.

media.caption: UK calls Argentine action against Falklands companies 'unacceptable'
